title: Formes linéaires en deux logarithmes et déterminants d'interpolation
notes: Journal of Number Theory 55 (1995) 285-321. The general two-log tool cited by Simons-de Weger; they record that Rhin 1987 is sharper for the specific form x log 2 + y log 3.
